$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md section 18). Limits: title 63, description 400, seoTitle 60, seoDescription 160 (154 kept), 10 per actor; the account's cap of 100 public tasks may stop some (manager/CLAUDE.md traps). inputSchemaFields must stay fields of the input schema. options follow defaultRunOptions in store.json.

tasks.name: instahyre-jobs-last-24-hours
tasks.title: Find the newest Instahyre jobs posted in the last 24 hours
tasks.description: Get the 100 newest jobs posted on Instahyre in the last day, with company, city, experience range, skills and link. The date is read from each job page, since Instahyre shows it nowhere else. Set Number of jobs to 0 to get every one, and schedule it daily for a fresh feed.
tasks.seoTitle: New Instahyre Jobs in the Last 24 Hours
tasks.seoDescription: The newest jobs posted on Instahyre in the last day, with company, city, experience range, skills and link. Run it daily for a fresh India tech job feed.
